nota: 'including the first marine antivenoms in the world (1956: stonefish antivenom; 1970: box jellyfish)'. Os dois são 'the first marine antivenoms in the world', e o do peixe-pedra vem antes (1956); o de 1970 é o da água-viva. 'The world's first antivenom for a jellyfish' é a leitura fiel; nunca 'the world's first marine antivenom' para o de 1970.

texto_aprovado: This was Arbuckle's example, remember: box jellyfish live in warm seas well beyond Australia. What Australia added was a treatment, the world's first antivenom for a jellyfish.
